description_en: Updates the configuration of a listener, such as the name and default action
description_zh: 更新监听的配置，如名称、默认动作等
name: UpdateListenerAttribute

parameters.help_en: The listener ID of the Application Load Balancing (ALB) instance
parameters.help_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例监听ID
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, an `HTTP 2xx` status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会更新监听的配置。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回`HTTP 2xx`状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The custom listener name.

The name must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
自定义监听名称。

长度为2\~256个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、中文、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: listener_description

parameters.help_en:
The request timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 600.

If no response is received from the backend server within the timeout period, load balancing returns an `HTTP 504` error code to the client
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求超时时间。单位：秒。取值范围：1~600。

如果在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，负载均衡将放弃等待，给客户端返回`HTTP 504`错误码
parameters.name: request_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The idle connection timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 600.

If no access request is received within the timeout period, load balancing temporarily breaks the current connection and restores the connection when the next request arrives
parameters.help_zh:
指定连接空闲超时时间。单位：秒。取值范围：1~600。

如果在超时时间内一直没有访问请求，负载均衡会暂时中断当前连接，直到下一次请求来临时重新建立新的连接
parameters.name: idle_timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Gzip compression to compress specific types of files. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启Gzip压缩，对特定文件类型进行压缩。取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: gzip_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启HTTP/2特性。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
parameters.name: http2_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The security policy. System security policies and custom security policies are supported.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
安全策略，支持系统安全策略和自定义安全策略。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
parameters.name: security_policy_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable mutual authentication. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启双向认证。取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: ca_enabled

fields.help_en:
The custom header field name. This parameter takes effect only when XForwardedForClientCertClientVerifyEnabled is set to true.

The name must be 1 to 40 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters a to z, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and digits.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
自定义头字段名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertClientVerifyEnabled的值为true时，此值才会生效。

取值限制：长度1\~40个字符。支持字母a~z、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和数字。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_client_verify_alias

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Clientcert-clientverify` header field to retrieve the verification result of the client certificate that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Clientcert-clientverify`头字段获取对访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的校验结果。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_client_verify_enabled

fields.help_en:
The custom header field name. This parameter takes effect only when XForwardedForClientCertFingerprintEnabled is set to true.

The name must be 1 to 40 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters a to z, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and digits.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
自定义头字段名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertFingerprintEnabled的值为true时生效。

取值限制：长度为1\~40个字符。支持字母a~z、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和数字。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_fingerprint_alias

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Clientcert-fingerprint` header field to retrieve the fingerprint of the client certificate that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Clientcert-fingerprint`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的指纹取值。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_fingerprint_enabled

fields.help_en:
The custom header field name. This parameter takes effect only when XForwardedForClientCertIssuerDNEnabled is set to true.

The name must be 1 to 40 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters a to z, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and digits.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
自定义头字段名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertIssuerDNEnabled的值为true时才生效。

取值限制：长度为1\~40个字符。支持字母a~z、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和数字。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_issuer_dn_alias

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Clientcert-issuerdn` header field to retrieve the issuer information of the client certificate that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Clientcert-issuerdn`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的发行者信息。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_issuer_dn_enabled

fields.help_en:
The custom header field name. This parameter takes effect only when XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNEnabled is set to true.

The name must be 1 to 40 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters a to z, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and digits.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
自定义头字段名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNEnabled的值为true时才生效。

取值限制：长度为1\~40字符。支持字母a~z、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和数字。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_subject_dn_alias

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Clientcert-subjectdn` header field to retrieve the owner information of the client certificate that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Clientcert-subjectdn`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的所有者信息。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_subject_dn_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow ALB to retrieve the real client IP address from the X-Forwarded-For header field. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false: disabled.

HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否允许ALB从X-Forwarded-For头字段中查找真实客户端IP。取值：

true：是。
false：否。

HTTP、HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_source_ips_enabled

fields.help_en:
The trusted proxy IP addresses.

Application Load Balancing (ALB) traverses the `X-Forwarded-For` header field from right to left and selects the first IP address that is not in the trusted IP list as the real client IP address. This IP address is used for source IP-based rate limiting
fields.help_zh:
指定可信的代理IP。

应用型负载均衡ALB会从后往前遍历`X-Forwarded-For`，选取第一个不在可信IP列表中的IP作为真实的客户端IP，该IP会被用于源IP限速
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_source_ips_trusted

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Client-srcport` header field to retrieve the port of the client that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled.

HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Client-srcport`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端的端口。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_src_port_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-For` header field to retrieve the real IP address of the client. Valid values:
true (default): enabled.
false: disabled.

If you set this parameter to true, XForwardedForProcessingMode defaults to append and can be changed to remove.
If you set this parameter to false, the `X-Forwarded-For` header field is retained without additional processing before the request is sent to the backend server.
HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-For`头字段获取来访者真实IP。取值：
true（默认值）：是。
false：否。

配置true，XForwardedForProcessingMode默认取值append，支持修改为remove。
配置false，将请求发送至后端服务之前保留`X-Forwarded-For`头字段，不做额外处理。
HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Host` header field to retrieve the domain name of the client that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false (default): disabled.

HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否开启通过`X-Forwarded-Host`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端的域名。取值：
true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

HTTP、HTTPS和QUIC监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_host_enabled

fields.help_en:
The processing mode for the `X-Forwarded-For` header field. This parameter takes effect only when XForwardedForEnabled is set to true. Valid values:
append (default): append.
remove: remove.

If you set this parameter to append, the last-hop IP address is appended to the `X-Forwarded-For` header field before the request is sent to the backend server.
If you set this parameter to remove, the `X-Forwarded-For` header is removed before the request is sent to the backend server, regardless of whether the request contains the `X-Forwarded-For` header field.
HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
处理`X-Forwarded-For`头字段的模式。只有当XForwardedForEnabled为true时，此值才会生效。取值：
append（默认值）：附加。
remove：删除。

配置append，将请求发送至后端服务之前把最后一跳IP加入`X-Forwarded-For`头字段。
配置remove，将请求发送至后端服务之前删除`X-Forwarded-For`标头，无论请求是否携带`X-Forwarded-For`头字段。
HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_processing_mode

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header field to retrieve the listener protocol of the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled.

HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Proto`头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听协议。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

HTTP、HTTPS和QUIC监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_proto_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `SLB-ID` header field to retrieve the load balancing instance ID. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled.

HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`SLB-ID`头字段获取负载均衡实例ID。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

HTTP、HTTPS和QUIC监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_slb_id_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Port` header field to retrieve the listener port of the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled.

HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Port`头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听端口。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

HTTP、HTTPS和QUIC监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_slb_port_enabled

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the XForwardedFor feature
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_config

fields.help_en:
The ID of the QUIC listener to be associated. This parameter is required when QuicUpgradeEnabled is set to true. This parameter is valid only for HTTPS listeners.

The original listener and the associated QUIC listener must belong to the same ALB instance, and the QUIC listener must not have been previously associated
fields.help_zh:
需要关联的QUIC监听ID。QuicUpgradeEnabled值为true时必选。HTTPS监听时有效。

原始监听和关联的QUIC监听必须属于同一个ALB实例，并且此QUIC监听之前没有被关联过
fields.name: quic_listener_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable QUIC upgrade. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled.

This parameter is valid only for HTTPS listeners
fields.help_zh:
是否开启QUIC升级。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTPS监听时有效
fields.name: quic_upgrade_enabled

parameters.help_en: The configuration information when an associated QUIC listener is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 启用关联QUIC监听时的配置信息
parameters.name: quic_config

fields.help_en:
The default certificate ID. Only one default server certificate is supported.

This parameter is required when the listener protocol type is HTTPS or QUIC.
To add more server certificates, invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2254830.html to configure extension certificates after the listener is created
fields.help_zh:
默认证书ID，目前仅支持添加 1 个默认服务器证书。

监听协议类型为HTTPS或QUIC时，此参数为必填。
如需更多服务器证书，可在创建监听后调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2254830.html配置扩展证书
fields.name: certificate_id

fields.help_en:
The CA certificate ID.

This parameter is required when CaEnabled is set to true
fields.help_zh:
CA证书ID。

当CaEnabled参数取值为true的时候，此参数为必填
fields.name: certificate_id

parameters.help_en: The CA certificate list. Only one CA certificate is supported
parameters.help_zh: CA证书列表。目前仅支持添加1个CA证书
parameters.name: ca_certificates

fields.help_en: The ID of the destination server group to which requests are forwarded
fields.help_zh: 转发到的目的服务器组ID
fields.name: server_group_id

fields.help_en: The list of forwarding destination server group tuples
fields.help_zh: 转发目标服务器元组列表
fields.name: server_group_tuples

fields.help_en: The forwarding configuration for the action. This parameter is required and valid only when Type is set to ForwardGroup. You can add up to 20 forwarding action configurations
fields.help_zh: 转发动作对应的配置，Type类型为ForwardGroup时必填且有效。最多支持添加20个转发动作对应的配置
fields.name: forward_group_config

fields.help_en:
The action type. You can add up to one action type.

Valid values: ForwardGroup, which indicates that requests are forwarded to multiple server groups
fields.help_zh:
动作类型。最多支持添加1个动作类型。

取值：ForwardGroup，表示转发至多个服务器组
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The list of default rule actions
parameters.name: default_actions
